svg.title: A map of memory systems
svg.desc: A map of memory systems on two axes: who writes the memory (nobody, a pipeline, the answering agent, a background process) and whether the read path inserts everything or selects. Nobody writes: full context inserts everything; plain retrieval, and Claude's and ChatGPT's search over past chats, select. A pipeline writes: Mem0 and Zep/Graphiti select. The answering agent writes: Letta's core memory blocks and ChatGPT's saved memories are inserted; Letta's archival store and Claude's API memory tool select. A background process writes: textual memory, Mastra's Observational Memory and ChatGPT's dreaming summary are inserted; Honcho selects.
svg.text: Two choices place every system: who writes the memory, and whether the read path puts all of it into the prompt or
